images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D game sprite sheet, transparent background. Match the reference infantry's cute chibi anime game art: huge head, tiny feet, very short body, thick dark-brown outlines, clean simple flat colors, minimal highlights, readable at 80 screen pixels. EXACTLY 12 non-overlapping full-body sprites in an evenly spaced 4-column by 3-row grid on a 4:3 landscape image (1536x1152). Every cell same size and scale, generous transparent margins, soles at the same baseline 90% down each cell. Row 1 faces DOWN toward viewer, row 2 faces RIGHT profile, row 3 faces UP away from viewer, true back view. LEFT is mirrored in the game. Columns 1 and 2 are two visibly DIFFERENT alternating walk cycle contact poses: left foot forward/right back then right foot forward/left back, opposite arm swing and robe hem. Column 3 is attack windup, column 4 attack release. SAME character design in all cells. No text, no labels, no grid lines, no backgrounds, no floor shadow, no motion trails baked in, no crop, no merged cells. The first reference is the layout/style reference. The second is the old enemy identity reference. Turn this yellow-turban foot soldier into a comical YELLOW TURBAN ARCHER, no spear: retain black short hair/topknot, small dark moustache, yellow headband/robe, brown belt, tiny brown boots, add compact wooden bow and a back quiver of thin arrows. Walk columns hold bow down at side; column 3 draws bowstring toward cheek with one arrow nocked; column 4 releases with bow extended and string relaxed, empty drawing hand recoils, no arrow flying outside the cell. Maintain clear bow silhouette and four readable direction/attack poses.
